Title: Generally Available: Azure Functions support for Python 3.14

Body.Content:
You can now develop functions using Python 3.14 locally and deploy them to Azure Functions plans on Linux. 

Upgrade your apps to Python 3.14 to take advantage of enhanced security, a longer support window, and continued compatibility with the Azure Functions runtime and developer tools. 

Learn more:  

  • Upgrade your app to Python 3.14 
  • Python support in Azure Functions
